review_note: Exact original bytes, not new generation. All data arithmetic in three Triton kernels, metadata allocation/compile/stream on host. Maskless path n divisible by block; stride path uses logical indices. Cache holds callable/current keyed address, not output data; current pointer and dtype/contiguity checked. Single-device fixed contract only: device omitted from address cache key is an unresolved multi-device limitation. Full special-value and numerical checks required. No claim of new performance optimization.
